title: Effects of operating temperature on kinetics and performance of iron/iron redox flow batteries
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6YA00077K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Challuri Sai Venkata Akhil Kumar, Arghyadeep De, Hubert Weyrauch, Jens Tübke, Jens Noack
Elevated temperatures accelerate iron deposition but compromise structural integrity, causing capacity fade without dendrite formation, revealing a critical trade-off for stable long-term flow battery cycling.
